name: Westside Pavilion
description: Westside Pavilion is a shopping center located on the Westside of Los Angeles, strategically positioned near major entertainment and business districts. Originally opened as a traditional enclosed mall, the property has undergone significant transformation in recent years to adapt to changing retail dynamics and now serves as a mixed-use destination.
summary: A historically significant West Los Angeles shopping destination currently undergoing redevelopment and transformation from traditional retail mall to mixed-use property.
